title: Unit Event — Kick It Up a Notch — Episode1 A Phone Call

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD is all set to perform at "Crawl Green" and are very excited about it. Kohane and the others are also looking forward to seeing Taiga there, but he happens to get a phone call which...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
S-So, Shiraishi and Tono...
Do you think they're still in talks with Crawl Green?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It has been taking them quite a long time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, that owner isn't gonna budge so easily. We just have to hope that their negotiations are going well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone seems anxious about this. Even I'm uneasy...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Today is the day we're supposed to find out whether or not we get to do our event there. Also...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Taiga said he'd come and watch.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Taiga's really coming to see our event?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That is, if we manage to book Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all want to see Taiga there.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And so do I... I really want to see how he reacts after seeing our event...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want him to see where I'm at now in terms of singing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An, Tono! Welcome back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, we're back!
Man, that was nerve-wracking! I really hate doing these sorts of negotiations!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Shiraishi. You as well, Tono.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: S-So, how'd it go?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We were given the green light.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We appreciate it, you guys.
Thanks for going over to talk to them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you both so much, An, Tono!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, you're giving us too much credit. I believe our second event actually did most of the talking for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Totally! The owner sat there really quietly as he watched the video of it... And then, at the end, he asked, “When do you want to perform?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That's great since we all felt very good about it afterwards.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! So, this win was a team effort!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
We made sure to remind the owner about that other thing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Remember what Arata said...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I told him, “We're going to put on an event that's even better and more packed than the one RADder put on when they debuted!”

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember. So, you were serious about that.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Of course I was. I mean, surpassing RAD WEEKEND will remain a pipe dream if we don't believe we can.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the owner quickly responded to that by saying, “Don't get ahead of yourselves!”

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
I can imagine...
He's always been a tough judge to please.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Also, Akito... He surprised us by asking that we relay a message to you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To me...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: “I remember you and what you look like. If you mess up again, that's it for you.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He remembers...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But that doesn't matter...
Because we get to do our next event at Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Which means Taiga's going to come see us perform!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, you all sound pretty excited today.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, Ken!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I take it you just received some good news? Why don't you all have a round of drinks on me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks, Dad!
I'll get everyone's orders now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for always being so generous.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Don't mention it. You guys are regulars here after all.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: By the way, I just overheard some of the conversation you were just having. Is it true...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Are you talking about us playing at Crawl Green?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
There's that, but...
Is Taiga actually going to see your next event?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, Ken. What's...? Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga! Perfect timing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You gotta hear this! We just got the green light to do our next event at Crawl Green!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh? You actually managed to get that old geezer to listen? Not bad.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which means I need to fulfill my promise...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness...! That means you're coming to see us...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hey, relax.
I'm just one extra spectator.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Still, having to go all by myself doesn't seem right... So, Ken...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Wanna come with?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Alright...
I should every so often.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Dad, you're gonna come see us perform...?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, since it's pretty rare of Taiga to invite me like this. I feel that not accepting would be a bad idea.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hah hah hah. You can thank the great Taiga for your thriving business!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Anyway, add two more to the guest list. Once you guys have hammered out all the details... Tell Ken.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing your event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Whoa, no way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Taiga coming to watch is already scarcely believable, but Ken's joining him...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. I'm starting to get really nervous...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, An, mind taking everyone's orders...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? R-Right! Gimme one sec...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Alright, Taiga, what'll you have?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I need to take this...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Never a dull moment...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, here's the pizza!
Mind moving your cups and stuff for me?!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
I'm taking a slice while it's still nice and hot!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
(Taiga still hasn't come back...
I guess that call's taking longer than expected.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
(But it's going to be dark soon...
I should turn the light on for the sign.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Hm...? That sounded like...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, start in Los Angeles and work our way across the country to New York? Not bad.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Alright, got it...
I'll be heading back soon, so we can discuss contracts and all that then.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, Ken. Were you there the whole time?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: You're going back to the States?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What's that? Were you eavesdropping on my call?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: A musician friend called to ask if I'd be interested in doing a US tour. I sort of can't refuse...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you just...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, there you two are...
I need to head home soon, so I thought I should say bye before I did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
What you made for us was really good.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
Come back whenever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I will! Oh, also, Taiga...
I'm looking forward to practicing again next week!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You're so old-fashioned.
Anyway, see you then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad, I'm gonna see Kohane out!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sure thing. It's getting dark, so be careful, okay?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I've seen this look on Taiga's face before.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Taiga wants Kohane and her to...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you going to leave your student behind...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What? Are you talking about us practicing...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
It was just an old man's whim.
Unfortunately for her, that's all the time I've got.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you promised her that...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I promised her what...?
More importantly, I'm parched. A beer sounds great right about now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Pace yourself.
I'm pretty sure it's going to rain tonight.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I should have remembered the forecast said it would rain tonight... Thanks for letting me borrow one of your umbrellas.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, don't worry about it! We keep these around just in case this sort of thing happens!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, today was packed full of surprises...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only is Uncle Taiga gonna come see our event, so is my dad now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I couldn't believe it... And I'm really happy. I want to make it a good event if they're both going to be there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, as prickly as you, your dad and the others said he is, I want the owner to acknowledge us as being good...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Which is why I want to make the most of my practice with Taiga next week...!)
